sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Long Line is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Barev, brother! I need your help, and I need it quick. I sent my guys to Ultra to pick up some gear, but a group of PMCs cornered them there. My bois had no choice but to pull out empty-handed. I've got a business to run here, deliveries to make, important people waiting! Brother, deal with those fuckers for me. I'll owe you one!"

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Energy-saving lamp

"Respect, brother, you helped me out big time! If you see any dangerous dudes in Ultra, you let me know. Might need you to deal with them again."
